title: Kubernetes stories vs Java stories on points
question: Does a story about Kubernetes get more points than a story about Java?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about Kubernetes gets more points than a story about Java.
expect: If true, points per story for Kubernetes stories should be at least 1.5x the value for Java stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, Kubernetes against Java

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h316 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h316 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
